title: From Bacterial Immunity to Biotech Revolution: The Comprehensive History and Discovery of CRISPR Technology
description: This article traces the journey of CRISPR technology from its initial discovery as a bacterial immune mechanism to its current status as a revolutionary gene-editing tool. It explores the foundational science, methodological evolution, therapeutic applications, key challenges, and optimization strategies, synthesizing historical context with the latest clinical advancements.
audience: researchers, scientists, and drug development professionals
